reviews.title: Great headset
reviews.comment: Best ANC headset I’ve used for work. I work in an open office tied to a warehouse with consistent slamming doors and conversations and this headset lets me focus on my calls. Mic quality is also pretty good with it focusing on my voice and ignoring all the other noise. Overall great headset for the money
reviews.author: Isaac Thompson

reviews.title: Highly recommend for all working professionals!
reviews.comment: Great headset, truly noise cancelling, and background noise is cancelled out while I’m speaking into the microphone. My coworkers gave me their opinions on how I sounded in calls and they said the mic is extra crispy and clear, and I even had my husband sing loudly in the background to see if my coworkers could hear him and they said they couldn’t! Very comfortable headset, love that it’s wired, and comes with a nice case. Highly recommend for anyone working remotely in loud places or have pets or children at home while in meetings.
reviews.author: Joe Shmannon

reviews.title: Well worth it! If you need a quiet area to work or study!
reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/G1Wgnu6+S2L.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/517Sgk-qe9L._SY256.jpg The fit is comfortable, the design is sleek and professional, the portability is good because you can use the usb a on computer or laptop and USB c on iphone. The value for the money is pretty fair because if the sound quality. On my laptop it was literally plug and play but then when I tried on my cell phone the first call sound was distorted but after calling back they could not hear my background on the other end of the call. Overall the quality is good if you need them for work or study meetings etc and need to minimize distractions and background noises. 9/10 Score
reviews.author: C. Smith

reviews.title: Great for shared office! Mic noise cancellation is incredible
reviews.comment:
TLDR: mic cancellation = amazing, price = not too bad, not budget, features = too cool, buy them? = yes!
My husband and I share an office and I had no idea that my airpods werent great at noise cancelling during my meetings until a co worker brought it up. He is on calls all day and have a very loud voice.
I watched too many youtube videos demo-ing noice cancelling mics over 3 days and after putting a few choices in my cart I decided on these because of the reviews and price.
You CANNOT tell there is a person less than 10ft from me talking to people all day. I recorded a sample video on both google meets and zoom. Both times you couldnt hear anything in my background. We used an noise decibel app and his voice projects around 60-75 decibels depending on how loud hes talking for reference.  They are a bit pricey for just a headset but worth the piece of mind.
Im about to buy a second pair for my husband bc he says they fit his head better than his work issued headset.
The only gripe I had (which was resolved) was the annoying "muted" "unmuted" voice prompt when I would mute and unmute BUT I discovered the epos connect app and that feature and many other features can be customized. I chose the tone prompt, theres also an option to remove a prompt all together. I also love that there is a little red light on the mic when your muted to avoid whoosy during calls, like singing when you think your on mute lol They were just plug and use.
reviews.author: Ceci n Ed

reviews.title: The WFH Customer Service Agent's greatest ally!
reviews.comment:
I've been using this headset for a couple of weeks and can confidently say it is the best headset I've ever used.
I researched for a few weeks before settling on this one and was serious about testing it. I've tried it in a myriad of situations, some more noisy than others to test its mic: while standing next to a working washing machine and dryer, while my family members scream from a couple of steps away, while my home office window is open and the family dog is barking its head off along with the dogs next door and across the street, while there's a loud TV nearby, and on a memorable occasion while my mother was blasting music right outside my door, and when I say nothing is heard besides your voice, I MEAN THE PEOPLE YOU'RE SPEAKING TO CAN ONLY HEAR YOU. It is seriously amazing!
Now, regarding the headset's ANC, I've only used it on especially noisy days and it works remarkably well, though I have to confess I rarely use it since prolonged ANC use gives me headaches, so I can't attest to its full potential, but the mic is a godsend.  I don't much care if I can hear the world happening around me so long as my clients cannot, especially dogs, rain, music, or even my ceiling fan.
It is comfy to use for prolonged periods, you can easily pick up oncoming calls with the button, and mute or unmute yourself by adjusting the mic.
It even helped my productivity because now I don't have to wait for the passing truck, the construction noise or the dogs to quiet down before taking or making another call. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Karina V
